Name: Retextured Summer Bushes
Author: carmenbutterfly
Description:
The decorative palm trees in town are still present. Other than that, all the summer bushes now look similar to their seasonal counterparts.

**This WILL alter the appearance of the bushes on Ginger Island. If you want the original textures to still be on Ginger Island, use the alternate file.

I'm totally open to altering textures from recolor mods. So feel free to suggest! :)

Manifest.Name: Retextured Summer Bushes
Manifest.Description: retextures the ugly summer bushes to look similar to the bushes in spring, fall, and winter
Manifest.Author: carmenbutterfly
